task: Athlete's-heart structural remodeling CERT: chronic exercise remodels the LV via the Laplace wall-stress stimulus (sigma=Pr/2h, equivalently sigma=P/RWT since RWT(ASE)=2h/r) -- endurance/volume-overload -> eccentric hypertrophy (cavity dilation + proportional wall thickening, normal/low RWT) vs strength/isometric-pressure-overload -> concentric hypertrophy (wall thickening without dilation, high RWT), the Morganroth hypothesis. Falsifier: reproduce the Pluim et al 2000 meta-analytic endurance-vs-strength LV geometry divergence from raw reported numbers; force the 'wall-thickness-alone-predicts-pathology' adversary to its strongest fair form (same-cohort compound cavity+wall index) and show it fails while the compound index succeeds; reproduce the multi-criterion physiological-vs-HCM separation (cavity size, diastolic/reversibility, genetics); anchor the dysfunction pole (HCM as the leading cardiovascular cause of athletic sudden death; hypertensive/general-population LV mass as an independent mortality predictor -- the SAME structural axis with OPPOSITE prognostic valence depending on context). Complementary to docs/MECHANISM_CARDIAC_OUTPUT.md, which resolved SV=EDV-ESV + CO=HRxSV + Frank-Starling-preload at rest/max-exercise but explicitly left the endurance-vs-strength training-adaptation branches OPEN (its Sec 0).

pluim_2000_meta_analysis.cite: Pluim BM, Zwinderman AH, van der Laarse A, van der Wall EE (2000). The athlete's heart. A meta-analysis of cardiac structure and function. Circulation 101(3):336-44.
pluim_2000_meta_analysis.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session (full abstract fetched)
pluim_2000_meta_analysis.numbers: n=59 studies, 1451 athletes. Relative wall thickness (RWT): control 0.36 vs endurance 0.39 (P=0.001) vs combined 0.40 (P=0.001) vs strength 0.44 (P<0.001). Endurance vs strength RWT 0.39 vs 0.44 (P=0.006); IVS 10.5 vs 11.8mm (P=0.005); PWT 10.3 vs 11.0mm (trend P=0.078); LVID 53.7 vs 52.1mm (trend P=0.055). No significant EF/FS/E-A difference vs control (function preserved).

macdougall_1985_resistance_bp.cite: MacDougall JD, Tuxen D, Sale DG, Moroz JR, Sutton JR (1985). Arterial blood pressure response to heavy resistance exercise. J Appl Physiol 58(3):785-90.
macdougall_1985_resistance_bp.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session. NOTE: initial recalled PMID (3980356) was WRONG (single-digit drift) -- corrected via esearch by title/author terms, not trusted from memory.
macdougall_1985_resistance_bp.numbers: n=5 experienced bodybuilders, direct brachial intra-arterial catheter. Double-leg press to failure: group mean peak 320/250 mmHg (one subject exceeded 480/350). Single-arm curl: mean peak 255/190 mmHg. Confirms mechanical+Valsalva+pressor combination produces extreme transient pressure overload.

lentini_1993_lv_volumes_lifting.cite: Lentini AC, McKelvie RS, McCartney N, Tomlinson CW, MacDougall JD (1993). Left ventricular response in healthy young men during heavy-intensity weight-lifting exercise. J Appl Physiol 75(6):2703-10.
lentini_1993_lv_volumes_lifting.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session
lentini_1993_lv_volumes_lifting.numbers: Leg press to failure at 95% max: EDV 147->103mL, ESV 54->27mL (BOTH decrease, P<0.05) while systolic BP 160->270 Torr and diastolic BP 91->183 Torr (both increase, P<0.05); SV fell 94->77mL. Direct, real-measured evidence that isometric/resistance loading delivers a near-pure pressure signal with REDUCED (not increased) preload -- the geometric opposite of the endurance stimulus.

daida_1996_peak_exercise_bp_norms.cite: Daida H, Allison TG, Squires RW, Miller TD, Gau GT (1996). Peak exercise blood pressure stratified by age and gender in apparently healthy subjects. Mayo Clin Proc 71(5):445-52.
daida_1996_peak_exercise_bp_norms.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session
daida_1996_peak_exercise_bp_norms.numbers: n=7863 men + 2406 women, Bruce-protocol treadmill. 90th-percentile peak SBP age 20-29: 210mmHg (men), 180mmHg (women), rising with age. Used as a disclosed general-population (not elite-endurance-specific) proxy for dynamic-exercise peak pressure.

boraita_2022_sport_specific_norms.cite: Boraita A et al (2022). Normative Values for Sport-Specific LV Dimensions and Exercise-Induced Cardiac Remodeling in Elite Spanish Male and Female Athletes. Sports Med Open 8(1):116.
boraita_2022_sport_specific_norms.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session (re-confirms and extends the repo's own prior graph extraction)
boraita_2022_sport_specific_norms.numbers: n=3282 elite athletes, 46 sports. 85.4% normal geometry; eccentric hypertrophy 13.4%; concentric remodeling/hypertrophy each <0.8% (RARE). P95: septal WT 12mm(M)/10mm(F); PWT 11mm(M)/10mm(F); LVEDD 64mm(M)/57mm(F).

czimbalmos_2019_grey_zone_discriminator.cite: Czimbalmos C et al (2019). The demanding grey zone: Sport indices by CMR differentiate HCM from athlete's heart. PLoS One 14(2):e0211624.
czimbalmos_2019_grey_zone_discriminator.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session (re-confirms and extends the repo's own prior graph extraction)
czimbalmos_2019_grey_zone_discriminator.numbers: n=150 elite athletes (>18h/wk training) + 194 HCM + 10 athlete-with-HCM. 47.5% of male / 4.1% of female athletes reach EDWT 13-16mm grey zone. EDWT/LVEDVi AUC 0.998(CQ)/0.999(TQ). Cutoff EDWT/LVEDVi(TQ)<1.27: sens 89.2%, spec 91.3%. Cutoff LVM/LVEDV(CQ)<0.82: sens 77.8%, spec 86.7%.

pelliccia_2002_detraining_reversal.cite: Pelliccia A, Maron BJ, De Luca R, Di Paolo FM, Spataro A, Culasso F (2002). Remodeling of LV hypertrophy in elite athletes after long-term deconditioning. Circulation 105(8):944-9.
pelliccia_2002_detraining_reversal.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session (independently re-confirms the repo's own prior graph extraction number-for-number)
pelliccia_2002_detraining_reversal.numbers: n=40, mean 5.6yr deconditioning. Cavity -7% (61.2->57.2mm, P<0.001); max wall thickness -15% (12.0->10.1mm, P<0.001); mass/height -28% (194->140 g/m, P<0.001). Wall thickness normalized in EVERY athlete (100%, 40/40). Cavity persistently dilated >=60mm in 9/40 (22%) -- reversibility is chamber-dependent, not uniform.

pelliccia_2022_hcm_nonreversal.cite: Pelliccia A et al (2022). Neither Athletic Training nor Detraining Affects LV Hypertrophy in Adult, Low-Risk Patients With HCM. JACC Cardiovasc Imaging 15(1):170-171.

pelliccia_2022_hcm_nonreversal.numbers: n=43 genetically/clinically-diagnosed low-risk HCM. 0% wall-thickness change across 15yr training + 7yr detraining (per prior extraction, unverified against primary text this session).

claessen_2024_genetic_overlap.cite: Claessen G et al (2024). Reduced Ejection Fraction in Elite Endurance Athletes: Clinical and Genetic Overlap With Dilated Cardiomyopathy. Circulation 149(18):1405-1415.

maron_2009_scd_registry.cite: Maron BJ, Doerer JJ, Haas TS, Tierney DM, Mueller FO (2009). Sudden deaths in young competitive athletes: analysis of 1866 deaths in the United States, 1980-2006. Circulation 119(8):1085-92.
maron_2009_scd_registry.verified_via: NCBI eutils esearch (by title/author terms, not a recalled PMID) + efetch, live this session

levy_1990_framingham_lv_mass_mortality.cite: Levy D, Garrison RJ, Savage DD, Kannel WB, Castelli WP (1990). Prognostic implications of echocardiographically determined left ventricular mass in the Framingham Heart Study. N Engl J Med 322(22):1561-6.
levy_1990_framingham_lv_mass_mortality.verified_via: NCBI eutils esearch + efetch, live this session
levy_1990_framingham_lv_mass_mortality.numbers: n=3220, 4yr follow-up, general population (age>=40, free of clinical CVD at baseline). RR per 50g/m LV-mass/height increment: CV disease incidence 1.49(men)/1.57(women); CV death 1.73(men)/2.12(women); all-cause death 1.49(men)/2.01(women). All risk-factor-adjusted, independent of BP/smoking/lipids/ECG-LVH.

kusy_2021_morganroth_counterexample.cite: Kusy K et al (2021). Aging Athlete's Heart: An Echocardiographic Evaluation of Competitive Sprint- versus Endurance-Trained Master Athletes. J Am Soc Echocardiogr 34(11):1160-1169.
kusy_2021_morganroth_counterexample.verified_via: NCBI eutils esearch + efetch, live this session
kusy_2021_morganroth_counterexample.numbers: n=143 sprint-trained + 114 endurance-trained master athletes (age 36-85). Sprint: 51.0% normal geometry, 4.2% eccentric hyp, 36.4% concentric remodel, 8.4% concentric hyp. Endurance: 22.8% normal, 16.7% eccentric hyp, 36.8% concentric remodel, 23.7% concentric hyp. EICR 'shifted toward normal geometry in sprinters and toward concentric remodeling/hypertrophy in endurance runners' -- OPPOSITE the classic Morganroth direction; authors state this explicitly as inconsistent with the hypothesis.

de_simone_1992_allometric_lv_mass.cite: de Simone G, Daniels SR, Devereux RB, Meyer RA, Roman MJ, de Divitiis O, Alderman MH (1992). Left ventricular mass and body size in normotensive children and adults. J Am Coll Cardiol 20(5):1251-60.
de_simone_1992_allometric_lv_mass.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, live this session (already cited in the repo's ORG-EXTREME-MASS-ORGAN-STRAIN graph node; re-confirmed independently here)
de_simone_1992_allometric_lv_mass.numbers: n=611 pooled. LV mass ~ height^2.7 (r=0.84) or BSA^1.5 (r=0.88). Indexing by height/BSA without allometric correction introduces artifactual mass-vs-size relations -- supports NOT misreading large-body-size (obesity or simply big athletes) as pathological hypertrophy without proper scaling; secondary/methodological support, not a core numbered gate.

gates_summary.athlete_vs_hcm_wt_alone_adversary: FALSIFIED as pre-registered (52.5pct specificity ceiling for WT-alone in Czimbalmos's own highly-trained male cohort; same-paper compound EDWT/LVEDVi index reaches 91.3pct specificity / AUC 0.999, clearing the void floor (AUC 0.5) by >0.4)
gates_summary.reversibility_discriminator: PASS (100pct wall-thickness normalization in true athletes, Pelliccia 2002, vs 0pct change over 15+7yr in genetically-confirmed HCM, Pelliccia 2022 -- opposite directions on the identical measurement axis, group label assigned independently of the reversibility measurement itself)
gates_summary.genetics_discriminator: PASS directionally (PRS OR=11, P=0.034) but explicitly caveated as underpowered (n=1 SCD event)
gates_summary.pluim_population_dichotomy_reproduced: PASS (RWT strength 0.44 > combined 0.40 > endurance 0.39 > control 0.36, all P<=0.006, reproduced directly from the paper's own raw numbers)
gates_summary.morganroth_dichotomy_universality: CORRECTLY REJECTED as a universal law (Kusy 2021 master-athlete cohort shows the reverse pattern); RETAINED as a real population-level central tendency -- symmetric QC applied to the repo's own headline finding, not just to the adversary.

symmetric_qc_open_items: The 'resting relative wall stress' table (Sec 2 of the script/doc) is a DIRECT MONOTONIC TRANSFORM of Pluim's own RWT ratios via sigma=P/RWT -- it is explicitly labeled TAUTOLOGICAL/not-an-independent-gate in both the script and this file, to avoid the appearance of a free confirmation. The actual falsifiable test is Sec 3 (forced-adversary necessity), which combines RWT (Pluim) with peak pressure (MacDougall/Daida) -- two independent sources that were not guaranteed to agree.

Full Laplace stress-normalization (equal peak sigma across endurance and strength groups after adaptation) does NOT hold (ratio 1.35, not 1.0) -- reported as a genuine partial/attenuating effect (~33pct of the theoretical gap closed), not oversold as a perfect thermostat. This is the more defensible, real claim and explains why grey-zone/pathological crossover remains possible (the mechanism is not perfectly protective).

The endurance peak-pressure input (Daida 1996, 210mmHg 90th-percentile men 20-29) is a GENERAL apparently-healthy referral population, NOT elite-endurance-athlete-specific -- no live-verified athlete-specific peak-dynamic-exercise-BP dataset was found this session. Disclosed as a proxy; sensitivity-swept +-20pct to show the necessity gate is not knife-edge on this specific number.

MacDougall 1985's n=5 bodybuilder cohort and Pluim's 1451-athlete meta-analytic 'strength' category are not the SAME cohort -- population-mismatch across the two legs of the necessity test, same pattern already disclosed elsewhere in this repo (e.g. Higginbotham's cycling cohort used as a walking proxy in MECHANISM_CARDIAC.md).

Pelliccia 2022's exact n=43/0pct figures are NOT independently re-derived from primary text this session (paywalled research letter, no indexed abstract) -- existence/pubtype/authorship confirmed live via EuropePMC; the specific numbers are reused from this repo's own prior extraction. Flagged, not laundered.

The HCM-genotype leg (Claessen 2024 PRS) is directionally supportive but rests on a single SCD event (n=1/281) -- explicitly NOT claimed as a powered predictive anchor, consistent with the pre-existing graph's own disclosed caveat on this exact point.

No single cohort in this evidence base measures wall-stress DIRECTLY (invasive LV pressure + simultaneous echo geometry) in real athletes performing their own sport-specific peak effort -- the necessity test (Sec 3) is a cross-study reconstruction (Pluim's resting/interictal geometry x MacDougall's/Daida's separately-measured peak pressure in different cohorts), not a single-study direct measurement. This is the single largest scope gap versus a fully closed loop.

Kusy 2021's master-athlete reversal and Kooreman 2019's female-athlete 'mass rises but shape does not diverge' finding are both REAL, live-verified, disclosed complications of the classic two-bucket Morganroth dichotomy -- retained as open, unresolved regime-dependence (aging, sex, sport-mix) rather than smoothed into a single clean headline.
honest_gaps: No subject-specific data -- population-level literature model only, complementary scope identical to every other MECHANISM_* organ layer's own first-step disclosure.
Wall-stress necessity test (Sec 3) is a cross-study reconstruction (geometry from one cohort, pressure from different cohorts), not a single direct simultaneous measurement.
Endurance peak-pressure input is a general-population proxy, not elite-endurance-athlete-specific (disclosed, sensitivity-swept).
Full stress normalization does NOT hold exactly (partial attenuation only, ~33pct of the theoretical gap) -- reported honestly, not rounded up to a clean 'normalization confirmed' headline.
Pelliccia 2022's specific numbers are reused-not-reverified (paywalled letter, no abstract).
Genetics/PRS discriminator rests on a single SCD event -- directional only.

The Morganroth eccentric/concentric dichotomy is a real population-level central tendency (Pluim, P<=0.006), NOT a universal law -- a real, live-verified counter-example exists in master athletes (Kusy 2021) and a real complication exists in female college athletes (Kooreman 2019).
